description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git command behaviors, including various diff and diff-tree commands, conflict marker detection, and submodule handling tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success (exit code 0) with a description.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command returns a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail (non-zero exit code).

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Makes a commit, optionally with specific options.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal timer for the test harness.
